title: Sepp Holzer's Mountain Permaculture Farm
summary: Josef Holzer walks through his family's Krameterhof, one of Europe's oldest permaculture farms in the Austrian mountains, with fish ponds, terraces, fruit trees and grazing animals. It showcases water management and microclimates.
why: HN cites it as a realistic example of productive mountain farming and of growing hardy crops in cold alpine conditions.

quote.text: I think a more realistic approach to mountain farming would be what Sepp Holzer does in the Austrian Alps.
